product_one_liner.value: Doxis is an AI-powered enterprise content management platform for organizations managing large document volumes and complex processes, automating document capture, understanding, workflows and compliant archiving.

pricing_page.notes: Public vendor-listed AWS Marketplace pricing exists: 50 Doxis.Cloud Enterprise users are listed at $156,420 for 36 months; this is not a standalone pricing page on the company website.

employee_band.notes: The company reports more than 900 employees, which exceeds every permitted band; none of the supplied bands accurately represents the group.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog reviewed consists of product guidance, business use cases and expert commentary; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public Doxis AI.dp documentation covers integrations, capturing, configuration and API workflows.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Full Stack AI Engineer posting in Groningen, covering machine learning, computer vision and LLM-based systems.

model_provider.notes: Doxis AI.dp documents these as supported bring-your-own-provider integrations, plus OpenAI-compatible endpoints; this does not identify the default platform-managed model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are certification/audit claims; GDPR is explicitly claimed compliance, not a separate certification.

last_funding.notes: TA Associates strategic growth investment announced March 21, 2024, with Carlyle remaining invested; amount undisclosed. This was private equity investment, not a named venture series.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest identified equity funding was March 21, 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Public applicant portal lists Account Executive US, vacancy VN304, in Charlotte, with full job details.

launched_6mo.notes: October 19, 2026: announced a new SAP SuccessFactors Compensation integration that automatically generates personalized employee compensation statements; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: January 19, 2026: announced Andy Spence joining as Chief Revenue Officer and Jean Van Vuuren as VP Sales EMEA, alongside Yeelen Knegtering’s appointment as Chief AI Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A sales vacancy names Salesforce familiarity, and the product has an explicit Salesforce connector; these are visible stack/integration signals, not proof of an exclusive internal CRM deployment.
